note: The official Business admissions page permits eligible business students to add an Extended Major in Artificial Intelligence, Digital Media and Creative Arts, or Sustainability. These are modelled as three isolated Programme-local Major choices rather than one merged curriculum. Each list contains only the corresponding Extended Major component; the selected base Business Major remains a separate requirement and is not copied into every choice. The AI rows reuse the intake-specific 75-course EXTM-AI source. The DMCA PDF publishes 86 unique coded rows and requires at least 21 credits, at least 12 single-counted credits, the EMIA 4990/4991 capstone alternative, 15 or 12 elective credits respectively, at least 6 credits at 3000 level or above, at least 3 credits from each of Digital Media and Creative Arts, and at least one Creative Arts Area 1 course. HUMA 3105 and ISDN 1100 remain because the intake PDF lists them while noting their deletion. HUMA 3150 has variable 1-2 credits and uses local credits 0. The SUST PDF publishes 55 unique coded rows and requires at least 24 credits, at least 12 single-counted credits, the EMIA 4990/4991 and ENVR 3005/4340 alternatives, and 15 or 12 elective credits respectively with at least 6 credits at 3000 level or above. SUST 1001/2001/3001/4001 each have variable 1-4 credits and use local credits 0; CIVL 4560 remains with its deletion note. All three choices remain read-only with totalCreditRequired=0 and must not produce a graduation-completion percentage.
